title: PIP-MON components, their layers, and what actually proves each one

provenance.note: component presence verified by directory listing 2026-09-30
five build stages; stage 6 is the retrieval gate added 2026-09-30

prose: The program replaces the scripting, monitoring and tooling layer that F4SE, AddressLib, Buffout, po3, MCM, Canary and CKPE would otherwise provide, with no F4SE loader deployed. It ships its own CLI, terminal and control plane so a human or another provider's model can sit in and drive tasks. gate_covered is a boolean and it is FALSE more often than is comfortable: a fully green build is consistent with S0 being unproven and the facility plugin holding zero records, because the gate measures build integrity and has no goal-coverage dimension. That gap is the most important line in this file.

entries.name: vprobe
entries.role: Layer A candidate: VM hook, Zydis-backed probes, detour installation
entries.status: builds; 18/18 probes resolve; no vtable slot hooked

entries.name: CommonLibF4
entries.role: Reverse-engineered engine layouts; the source of truth for BSScript and vtable structure
entries.notes: include/RE/Bethesda/BSScript.h holds native declarations; include/RE/VTABLE_IDs.h is the vtable inventory. This is the most direct lead to unblocking Layer A, because the blocker is documented as needing a BSScript class declaration in method order.

entries.name: PipMon.psc
entries.role: Papyrus-visible API, every function Native Global
entries.notes: Must agree with PapyrusApi.cpp in both directions; the self-test asserts that.

entries.name: PipMonTestFacility.psc
entries.role: First script that calls the PipMon native surface; poses the S0 question
entries.status: compiles and deploys; the S0 capability it exists to prove is UNPROVEN
entries.notes: Caught by spec_lint: gate_covered was true while this entry own status said the probe had never reached a native. The gate covers the COMPILE, not the S0 REACHABILITY the file exists to test. A green stage 2 means the .psc is valid Papyrus, nothing more.

entries.name: V-Link
entries.role: Native-to-Papyrus data path; the contract in docs/IPC_PROTOCOL.md
entries.notes: docs/IPC_PROTOCOL.md is partly fiction; see HANDOVER section 11.

entries.name: Overseer / overseer_event_bridge
entries.role: Event bridge and anomaly detection over the wire
replaces: part of what MCM and Canary do

entries.name: overseer_cli
entries.role: The CLI, detector, envgate and ipc_client: where a human or another model sits in
entries.notes: This is the component the retrieval objectives were originally missing, which made the whole control plane invisible to search.

entries.name: xEdit headless validation
entries.role: Replace the CK for record validation and generation
entries.status: load proven at ~2m15s; NO report has ever been produced
entries.notes: The first attempt aborted on a non-existent API. Corrected, but unproven. Not gate covered because no gate exercises it.

entries.name: test facility
entries.role: The proving ground: a cell with fixtures, roster and probe
entries.status: plugin is 66 bytes, 0 records, CRC32 E1DD5E4D
entries.notes: Nothing has been generated. This is the single largest piece of unrealised intent.

entries.name: retrieval layer
entries.role: rag_index.py and rag_query.py: local BM25 over the workspace with provenance
entries.notes: Stage 6 exists because every retrieval invariant had previously been true only because someone remembered it.

entries.name: ai_watcher
entries.role: Live telemetry hook; publishes game state to a file so no agent blocks on a terminal
entries.status: working, polling fallback because watchdog is not installed
entries.notes: Adopted from a circulated snippet that watched a Data/F4SE path. Rewritten: this project deploys no F4SE loader, so that path could never be written.

entries.name: F4SE
entries.role: NOT a dependency, NOT a target API, NOT deployed
entries.status: no loader exists; any DLLs under Data/F4SE are inert
provenance: verified: no F4SE loader in the game root
entries.notes: Studied for structural logic and scope only. CommonLibF4 is a different matter: it is a layout library, so depending on it is depending on facts about the game.
